description: CHICAGO – Illinois House Speaker Emanuel “Chris” Welch is excited to bring back his annual Blue Christmas Toy Drive and Fundraiser for a 4th year. The event collects new toys and gifts for families in need this holiday season. It also raises funds for Democratic candidates across the state.&am

title: Illinois Speaker to Host 4th Annual Blue Christmas Toy Drive and Fundraiser Dec. 10 — VoteChrisWelch.com
